guards.what: Smog.cs's own docstring is literal: "This Affliction has no logic of its own." It declares no override at all, not even HasExtraCardText — nothing at the AfflictionModel layer to diverge on.
guards.maps_to: `SmogAffliction` (afflictions.py) is likewise a bare data-only subclass. Symmetric with the C#.

SmoggyPower.AfterCardPlayed (SmoggyPower.cs:24-33) afflicts every unafflicted Skill in the player's piles the moment ANY Skill resolves; AfterCardEnteredCombat (:35-41) afflicts a newly-entering Skill only if a Skill has ALREADY been played this turn (a history query); AfterSideTurnEnd (:43-53) sweeps every Smog affliction WITHOUT removing the power itself — unlike Ringing/Entangled/Bound, SmoggyPower is a persistent per-combat debuff (once triggered, playing further Skills keeps re-marking them every turn); ShouldPlay (:56-60) refuses to play a Smog-carrying card outright. Mirrored by `power/smoggy` (powers.py), already audited: rollup `deliberate-divergence` (a history-vs-flag substitution at the AfterCardEnteredCombat site, recorded as safe for the reason given there) with every other entry `faithful`. Applier confirmed ported: `sts2_rl/monsters/underdocks/living_fog.py`.
Smog overrides no `IsStackable`, inheriting AfflictionModel's default `False` (AfflictionModel.cs:127-130); `SmogAffliction` (afflictions.py) leaves the base `is_stackable = False` unoverridden.

Smog is card-scoped to the player's own Skill cards (no monster deck exists). UNLIKE Ringing/Entangled/Bound, the debuff POWER persists all combat (SmoggyPower never self-removes), but the AFFLICTION MARKERS are cleared every side-turn-end regardless — `AfterSideTurnEnd` sweeps every Smog affliction off `AllCards` each turn, so a Skill re-marked one turn is unmarked by the next unless a Skill is played again that turn. No AfterDeath override on SmoggyPower; carried by the player (enemy-inflicted), so no applier-death removal path applies.
